instruction: Adjust Chrome settings to restore your last session's tabs when you launch the browser.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting Chrome to 'Continue where you left off' startup mode. The evaluator uses the existing get_new_startup_page getter which checks the session.restore_on_startup field in Chrome Preferences file. When this value is 5, it means Chrome will restore previous session tabs. This is verified by reading the Chrome Preferences JSON structure where session.restore_on_startup is an integer value. The exact_match metric compares the result against expected value 'true'.
